newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FORMER WELSH INTERNATIONAL ALLCHURCH DIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER WELSH INTERNATIONAL ALLCHURCH DIES.

text.p: Former Welsh international striker Ivor Allchurch has died at his Swansea home, aged 67.
Allchurch made 68 appearances for Wales between 1951 and 1966, scoring 23 goals.
Allchurch, who played for Newcastle United, Cardiff City and Swansea Town, died on Wednesday night, a Welsh Football Association spokesman said.
He made 694 league appearances, scoring 251 goals.
